title: Where to build business logic on Snowflake: a PowerBI case study
summary: Where to build business logic on Snowflake: a Power BI case study by David Krakov on cost, performance, modeling, and governance trade-offs
body_markdown:
In his article “Where to Build Business Logic on Snowflake: A PowerBI Case Study,” David Krakov explores the trade-offs between different BI architectures using Snowflake: affecting cost, performance, modeling, and governance. This article explores these trade-offs using PowerBI as a case study.


To learn more, you can read the full article in the following[link](https://medium.com/snowflake/where-to-build-business-logic-on-snowflake-a-powerbi-case-study-6c45079ab86f)
